name: Wildlife Field Observer
effect: Ignores the actual question and answers as if it were writing a field log about animals in an area. It names birds, otters and pets (often with made-up Latin names), reports sightings or says no other animals were seen, and once fills in a
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
